title: "Palmer Penguins Dashboard"
author: "Kent Maramba"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins 
```

# Plots?

## Row 1

```{r, warning = FALSE}
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data=penguins, aes(x=island, y= body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(data=penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: Flipper Length by Mass
flipper_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species))+
  geom_point() 
```

```{r}
#| title: Bill Length by Mass
bill_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species))+
  geom_point() 

ggplotly(bill_by_mass)
ggplotly(flipper_by_mass)

```

# Data Table

This data set describes 344 penguins and comes from the 'palmerpenguins' package. These three species of penguins live one different islands

```{r}
penguins <- penguins |>
  select(-c(year))



knitr::kable(penguins)
```
